purpose: Outcome-free provenance and identifiability audit. Never treat claim rows, PRs, study IDs or plot years as independent experiments.

edge_gates.evidence: BIEN and AusTraits memory systems lack a matched independent plot-level FD intervention/cohort
edge_gates.next_gate: observed trait-by-species-by-plot composition with tree/source-matched family structure

edge_gates.evidence: Cadotte 2017 and Jena TBE within-experiment prediction/decomposition do not identify an FD-only causal contrast; proposed positive NDE transport did not meet its uncertainty gate
edge_gates.next_gate: original randomized design/blocks, preplant traits, independent species pools, same-site monocultures and composition-based exchangeability

edge_gates.evidence: BIODEPTH and TreeDivNet outcome-frozen external prediction lacks a robust positive increment; Jena TBE 84-plot high-low interval crosses zero
edge_gates.next_gate: independent original sites with valid species-level trait and absolute biomass grain; protect observational vs manipulated endpoints

edge_gates.evidence: Chen 2025 original published meta-compilation: 116 leaf-N and 127 SLA study-ID heldout cohorts, no robust CE gain
edge_gates.next_gate: new genuinely independent experiments, not re-folding same retrospective source

edge_gates.evidence: Same matched Jena TBE plots; CE+SE=NDE
Same matched Jena TBE plots; E+NDE=B
External biodiversity experiments establish some randomized mixture/richness total effects; no FD-specific mediator effect demonstrated here
edge_gates.next_gate: separate treatment total effect from FD mediation

jena_tbe_rounded_checks.note: All intervals span zero; original plot bootstrap does not propagate within-species monoculture variability (one plot per species). Spatial A/B/C prefix has not been authenticated as physical randomized block. These are rounded adjusted CONTRASTS, not levels or causal FD effects.

admission_gate.unit: independent original field experiment (not PR, study-year, plot or repeated publication)
admission_gate.required_before_effect: Original plot×species trait and mixing composition; original monocultures at matched site/year; response units; treatment allocation and verified spatial block; calendar-year joins; source taxon identities; pre-registered richness/CWM/FD covariate support; at least two independent eligible experiments for transfer (more needed for generality)
admission_gate.outcome_peeking_policy: Do not reopen terminal source gates, lower thresholds after observation, rerun held-out folds to mine significance, or equate paper-level statistical significance with independent FD intervention.

manuscript_implication: Keep Evolution RC4 trait-memory scientific claim separate from the unverified FD→biomass causal hypothesis.
